dag_infos.description: New Taipei City deaths by source age group and gender from the NTPC open-data gender statistics series. The 15-24 and 25-44 bands cross the 18-35 boundary, so the source is apportioned at query time; raw groups are never split in ETL.

data_infos.name_cn: 新北市死亡人數（按年齡組、性別）
data_infos.source_type: 新北市資料開放平臺 API
data_infos.dataset_description: 新北市死亡人數按年齡組與性別的年度資料。實測有效年度為2006–2023，API另回傳一列全空列；來源同時列出0歲新生兒細分、死亡年齡平均數與中位數；本DAG只取不重複的死亡年齡組計數，將0歲新生兒細分保留在來源說明而不重複加總。
data_infos.etl_description: Fetch the JSON array with a browser User-Agent, resolve field1 and item value2-item value17 by semantic role aliases, exclude the duplicated newborn subfields item value4-item value5 and mean/median fields, parse every emitted age label into integer bounds, and reconcile every year/gender input cell to the output. A three-times-median annual scale guard fails loud on unknown scope changes. The 15-24 and 25-44 bands are retained as-is; no 18-35 estimate is materialized.
